item.title: ONGC weighs standalone, joint venture models for new greenfield refinery
item.description: The state-run oil major is evaluating standalone, subsidiary and foreign partnership models for its proposed refinery, with capacity, investment and location yet to be finalised ...
item.dc:creator: Shubhangi Mathur
item.content:encoded: State-run Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd (ONGC) is evaluating various models for its proposed greenfield refinery and petrochemical complex, including setting it up independently, through a subsidiary, or in partnership with foreign players, people familiar with the matter said. “The project is in the initial stage and we are deciding the working model. Other specifications, such as location and configuration of the refinery will be worked out later,” a senior company executive said. The proposed refinery is also likely to have a higher petrochemical intensity, in line with rising domestic demand, the official said. The detailed feasibility report (DFR) will assess the refinery’s petrochemical configuration and potential, the official added. Questions sent to ONGC remained unanswered. The proposed greenfield refinery project assumes significance for ONGC's larger diversification and integration plan. The details regarding capacity and investment requirement for the project will be firmed up once the DFR is ready. Indian oil companies are pursuing a mix of greenfield refinery projects and expansions of existing plants to raise the country’s overall refining capacity. Earlier this month, oil minister Hardeep Singh Puri said India’s refining capacity of 267 million tonnes per annum (mtpa) helped ensure fuel availability despite supply disruptions during the peak of the West Asia conflict. The country’s refining capacity is expected to rise to 320 mtpa by 2030, he added. Countries such as Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates (UAE) have also shown interest in investing in upcoming Indian refinery projects, provided they see meaningful returns on their investments, said Puri. Meanwhile, state-run Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd (BPCL) is developing a 9 mtpa greenfield refinery-cum-petrochemical complex at Ramayapatnam in Andhra Pradesh, with final environmental clearance expected soon. Indian Oil Corporation Ltd (IOCL), along with its subsidiary Chennai Petroleum Corporation Ltd (CPCL), is setting up a 9- mtpa greenfield refinery in Nagapattinam, Tamil Nadu, with a focus on meeting the rising demand. In July, HPCL commissioned a 9 mtpa greenfield refinery-cum-petrochemical complex in Rajasthan. India currently has 5.33 million tonnes (mt) of SPR capacity across Visakhapatnam, Mangaluru and Padur, while another 6.5 mt planned under Phase II. ONGC received approval to develop a 1.75-mt strategic petroleum reserve at Mangaluru, Karnataka, as an extension of the existing SPR facility. The project, estimated to cost around ₹7,000 crore, will be developed and financed by ONGC. About half of the storage capacity is expected to be reserved for strategic use, while the company has sought government approval to commercially utilise the remaining capacity. ONGC has already acquired land for the project.

item.title: Nilekani panel explores last-minute question papers to prevent exam leaks
item.description: The task force is considering large question banks, AI-generated papers and wider computer-based testing to prevent leaks, with recommendations expected within three months of its formation ...
item.dc:creator: Auhona Mukherjee
item.content:encoded: The Centre’s task force on examination reforms is considering generating question papers at the last minute from a large question bank to prevent leaks. The panel is expected to submit its recommendations within three months of its formation on July 28, Nandan Nilekani, who heads the high-powered task force, said on Tuesday. Speaking at the Bloomberg New Economy Forum 2026, Nilekani said the National Eligibility-cum-Entrance Test (Undergraduate), or Neet (UG), paper leak had raised questions about the need for conventional question papers, given the financial incentive to obtain and sell them in advance. “So I think the question becomes, why do we need to have something called a question paper? Because the moment you have a question paper, that creates an economic incentive for that to be sold. So the way to do it is to really have a massive bank of questions. And only at the last minute, generate the question paper for that day,” he said. This approach would remove the financial incentive to obtain and sell question papers in advance, he added. Nilekani said artificial intelligence (AI) could also be used to generate question papers on the day of an examination to prevent leaks. The panel is also examining the expansion of computer-based testing, which would require a wider network of examination centres, he said. India currently has around 150,000 locations where candidates can take tests, and this network needs to expand, Nilekani observed. “We have 150,000 locations where a young boy or girl can take a test. That needs to be expanded. So I think these are all systemic issues which we will address in our committee,” he said. The committee would identify the root causes of examination-related problems and use technology to address systemic weaknesses, Nilekani said, adding that Prime Minister Narendra Modi was keen to implement its recommendations. Modi announced the formation of a high-powered task force led by the Infosys cofounder on July 26, following protests over the Neet (UG) 2026 paper leak and demands for accountability in the examination system. The Centre subsequently informed the Supreme Court that the panel would recommend reforms to strengthen the security and credibility of competitive examinations, particularly those conducted by the National Testing Agency. AI could help India improve literacy and numeracy among millions of people, Nilekani said. AI tools could also make information more accessible by allowing people to interact with computers in their preferred languages, he added. Nilekani dismissed concerns that AI would lead to widespread job losses in India’s information technology services sector, calling the argument “absolutely hogwash”. Companies would need greater support to fundamentally transform their operations using AI, creating more work for technology services firms, he said. “I think this is all disaster marketing to suit the interests of large capital. The fact of the matter is that the requirement for companies like Infosys or others is actually more than ever before because the transformation of enterprise is a very complex activity. And AI requires fundamentally reimagining the way you do business. And it’s a root and branch surgery that is required. And this, in fact, even more requires firms like ours to show companies how to go about making those transformations, how to reimagine the future,” he said. Nilekani said companies would need to transform their operations, reskill workers, and build new capabilities to adopt AI, adding that the technology’s capabilities were far ahead of its deployment. While AI coding agents would make coding more productive, he said, most of the work in technology projects extended beyond coding to include governance, change management, and business transformation. New jobs would emerge in understanding client requirements, coordinating teams, and ensuring AI systems did not hallucinate or behave unpredictably, he added. Small businesses could become a major source of job creation if AI improved their productivity and gave them better access to markets, capital, and information, Nilekani said. Millions of small enterprises could expand and hire more workers as a result, he added. India’s strength lay in applying AI at scale rather than competing solely to build models and computing infrastructure, Nilekani said, citing the country’s experience with digital public infrastructure such as Aadhaar and the Unified Payments Interface.

FAST

Oct 13 : Bumble is set to go private in a $1.3 billion deal with Ithaca Holdings after struggling for years to revive growth, as a prolonged decline in users and shifting Gen Z dating habits batter the online dating industry. Shares of the company soared 56 per cent to $5.95 in early trading on Tuesday, after surging 50 per cent on Monday following media reports on the Ithaca deal. Bumble and larger rival Match, which owns Tinder and Hinge, have been battling declining user engagement, as younger users increasingly grow tired of swiping endlessly on apps and seek more organic ways to build connections. Match has so far outperformed Bumble with its portfolio of apps that cater to niche demographics, as well as international growth at Hinge, which draws users with its detailed, relationship-oriented profile formats.

"With Hinge having gained and continuing to gain share of more intentioned daters, Bumble's niche has eroded. The management, brand, and strategy changes have also not helped," said Chandler Willison, TMT Research Analyst at M Science. Bumble said Ithaca co-founders Ravi Gupta and John Hegeman will become Bumble's co-CEOs after the takeover. The firm has offered $6.05 per share for Bumble, representing a 122.4 per cent premium to the stock's closing price on June 24, a day before Reuters exclusively reported the company was exploring a sale. AI TOOLS YET TO SPUR RECOVERY Founded in 2014 by Whitney Wolfe Herd, Bumble pioneered the "women-first" approach to online dating that has been a defining feature for the company. But it rolled back the feature this year in a bid to improve its user retention rates. Under Herd, who returned as CEO in March 2025 after stepping down in 2023, the company has tried everything from raising prices and extending reply windows to adding AI tools that help users craft messages and exploring offline events to keep users hooked. It has also been testing a new AI matchmaking assistant in response to traditional swiping fatigue. But that has failed to aid its recovery. Total paying users fell 16.4 per cent to 3.2 million in the second quarter, while quarterly revenue has been declining for nearly two years. Bumble's market value has shrunk to about $582 million as of Monday's close, a far cry from its $14 billion valuation when it went public in 2021. Blackstone, which owns about 14 per cent of Bumble, according to LSEG data, and Herd have provided required shareholder approval for the deal.

Source: Reuters

item.description: 韓国・仁川の商業施設で8人刺される、男拘束 1人重体 Reuters

item.title: 韓国・仁川の商業施設で8人刺される、男拘束 1人重体
item.description: [ソウル １３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ソウル １３日 ロイター] - 韓国警察は１３日、仁川市のショッピングモールで８人を刺した疑いで男を拘束したと発表した。聯合ニュースによると、被害者の１人は重体となっている。

警察によると、動機や事件の詳しい状況を捜査中。聯合ニュースが伝えた目撃者の話によると、男は両手に刃物をくくり付けていたとみられ、モール内の複数の階を移動しながら人々を襲った。その後、居合わせた人々に取り押さえられ、警察に引き渡された。

被害者は女性６人と男性２人。２０代の女性１人が命に関わる重傷を負い、近くの病院で手術を受けたという。

聯合ニュースによると、容疑者は５９歳で、殺人未遂で懲役４年の刑で服役していた。

法務省は声明で、男は２０１９年の出所後、監視用の電子足輪を装着しており、精神面の問題やアルコール依存症の治療を受けていたと明らかにした。電子監視制度は、殺人などで有罪判決を受けた人を対象とする犯罪防止策。

同省は、全地球測位システム（ＧＰＳ）によるリアルタイムの位置情報で追跡するこの制度について、徹底的に検証すると表明した。

仁川はソウルの西に位置する首都圏の一部で国際空港がある。

item.title: Dólar cae desde máximo de 18 meses, mercado aguarda datos de inflación
item.description: El dólar retrocedió el martes desde su máximo de 18 meses, a medida que los precios del petróleo bajaban y los inversionistas reevaluaban el repunte impulsado por la inteligencia artificial que ha respaldado la demanda de activos estadounidenses este año, a la espera de nuevas pistas sobre la trayectoria de las tasas de la Fed.
item.dc:creator: Stefano Rebaudo, Laura Matthews
item.content:encoded: El dólar retrocedió el martes desde su máximo de 18 meses, a medida que los precios del petróleo bajaban y los inversionistas reevaluaban el repunte impulsado por la inteligencia artificial que ha respaldado la demanda de activos estadounidenses este año, a la espera de nuevas pistas sobre la trayectoria de las tasas de la Fed. * "El dólar está retrocediendo a medida que crece el escepticismo sobre la solidez y la sostenibilidad de las valoraciones bursátiles relacionadas con la inteligencia artificial, lo que amenaza con frenar las entradas de capital en los mercados financieros estadounidenses", afirmó Karl Schamotta, estratega jefe de mercados de Corpay en Toronto. * El dólar amplió aún más sus pérdidas después de que el presidente de la Fed de Nueva York, John Williams, afirmara que sigue esperando una subida más de las tasas este año, pero que no ve necesidad de nuevas subidas en 2027. * Esto provocó que el índice del dólar estadounidense —que mide la fortaleza del dólar frente a una cesta de seis divisas— cayera un 0,37 %, hasta situarse en 102,18, tras alcanzar el lunes los 102,61, su nivel más alto desde abril de 2025. * Los mercados esperan que el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, evite una escalada en Oriente Medio, ya que un conflicto más amplio podría perjudicar su imagen de cara a las elecciones de mitad de legislatura del próximo mes. * Trump afirmó la semana pasada que EE. UU. no atacará a Irán antes de las elecciones, y el domingo mencionó un alto el fuego en materia energética entre Rusia y Ucrania. * Los precios del petróleo cayeron un 0,75 % hasta situarse en 105,87 dólares por barril el martes, mientras los operadores sopesaban la posibilidad de un aumento del suministro de gasóleo ruso. Rusia afirmó que puede restablecer las exportaciones de gasóleo por encima de los niveles que Trump esbozó en un acuerdo con Moscú. * Más allá del sector energético, los analistas señalaron que el reciente repunte del dólar también se ve amenazado por las crecientes dudas sobre el potencial de inversión impulsado por la inteligencia artificial. * Los inversionistas esperan ahora la publicación, el miércoles, del índice de precios al consumo de Estados Unidos correspondiente a septiembre, que debería aportar más pistas sobre un posible endurecimiento de la política monetaria de la Fed. * Los inversionistas abandonaron sus apuestas por una subida de tasas de la Fed a finales de este mes después de que dos responsables de política monetaria abogaran por recabar más datos antes de decidir si es necesario un mayor endurecimiento, mientras que el gobernador de la Fed, Christopher Waller, afirmó que las expectativas de inflación seguían "bien ancladas". * El yen se apreció un 0,18 %, hasta situarse en 158,33 frente al dólar, después de que los datos del Banco de Japón mostraran que los precios al por mayor subieron un 6,8 % en el año hasta septiembre, por debajo de la previsión media del mercado del 7,6 %, pero lo suficiente como para justificar los temores del mercado ante una subida de las tasas de interés.

Netflix secures rights to air 2030 World Cup in Spain, Andorra

FILE PHOTO: Jul 19, 2026; East Rutherford, New Jersey, USA; A view of the World Cup Trophy inside the stadium before the match the 2026 FIFA World Cup Final between Spain and Argentina at New York New Jersey Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Vincent Carchietta-Imagn Images/File Photo

FAST

Oct 13 : Netflix said on Tuesday it had secured the rights to broadcast the 2030 World Cup in Spain, which is co-hosting the tournament, and Andorra. It would be Netflix's first broadcast of a major men's international tournament in Spain, the company said. The 2026 World Cup was aired there by national channel TVE. California-based Netflix did not disclose financial terms. Under the deal, one game per matchday will be free to watch in Spain. Netflix will also offer a national free-to-air channel which will broadcast a package of matches that includes all of Spain's games, both semi-finals and the final.

Netflix did not name the channel. TVE declined to comment on whether it would be interested in purchasing a package of matches. Spain, which won the World Cup in North America this year, will co-host the 2030 edition with Portugal and Morocco, although Argentina, Paraguay and Uruguay will stage inaugural matches marking the tournament's 100th anniversary. Uruguay hosted the first World Cup in 1930. Spain's state-owned television network TVE broadcast the Spanish national team's matches during this year's tournament, while private platform DAZN, which distributed Mediapro's pay-TV World Cup channel, showed all 104 games. Netflix holds the rights in the US and Canada for the 2027 Women's World Cup being hosted by Brazil and the 2031 edition being staged jointly by Costa Rica, Jamaica, Mexico and the US. The deal in Spain is more evidence of Netflix's push into the sports broadcasting world, with NFL, MLB, WWE, boxing and MMA all appearing on the streaming platform.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Investigators hunt French supermarket fridge hackers, no claim of responsibility
item.description: French investigators on Tuesday were hunting the hackers who seized control of cooling units at hundreds of supermarkets in a cyberattack that underlined the vulnerabilities of connected systems, with no group publicly claiming responsibility.
item.dc:creator: Raphael Satter, Gabriel Stargardter
item.content:encoded: French investigators on Tuesday were hunting the hackers who [USN:L8N45Y11U TEXT:"seized control of cooling units"] at hundreds of supermarkets in a cyberattack that underlined the [USN:L6N45Z0J7 TEXT:"vulnerabilities of connected systems"], with no group publicly claiming responsibility. The investigation comes as Dutch supermarket company Ahold Delhaize (AD.AS) grapples with a separate cybersecurity incident that disrupted online services, although Dutch authorities said they saw no connection between the two events. The absence of a claim of responsibility by hacktivists or a ransom demand by cybercriminals has puzzled French investigators, according to a source with knowledge of the probe. Typically, such groups tend to quickly seek to monetise their hacks or claim credit for them for political ends. The cyberattack, which manually overrode the temperatures at fridges in supermarket groups including Carrefour (CARR.PA) , Monoprix, Intermarche and Cooperative U, appears to have been easy to pull off, three cyber experts told Reuters. Staff at some Paris supermarkets threw boxes full of perished meat and frozen goods into giant trash containers on Tuesday. At least 350 supermarkets — a small fraction of the total number in France - were caught up in the strike. FIRM BLAMES OUTDATED SOFTWARE France's cybersecurity agency has said the breach affected fridges that relied on software by Danish firm Danfoss, as well as Copeland and Dixell software. Danfoss said on Monday that many of the affected units had "reached end of life and no longer receive software or security updates" or were "running outdated firmware." It said it had "advised customers to keep supported systems updated with the latest firmware and to migrate legacy systems to current-generation solutions". The company declined further comment on Tuesday. Copeland, which owns Dixell, acknowledged the "vulnerability." "We are currently working with impacted customers to mitigate the risk," the company said, adding that it would strengthen cybersecurity. In Danfoss' case, the serious vulnerabilities present in older versions of its firmware have been known for months. On August 9, cybersecurity firm Claroty detailed weaknesses - since patched - in the Danfoss AK-SM 800A controller that could have allowed intruders to bypass authentication and run code on compromised devices. 'BASIC CYBER HYGIENE' Although the precise mechanism by which attackers compromised the refrigerators has not been publicly disclosed, cybersecurity experts said all signs pointed to a basic stunt enabled both by the failure to adopt Danfoss' updates and by exposing device interfaces to the internet. "This is about basic cyber hygiene," said Ken Munro, a partner at the British cybersecurity firm Pen Test Partners. "Get it wrong and you get a smelly mess of defrosted food." He said the well-known vulnerabilities meant the attackers were essentially pushing at an open door, something that meant the hack could easily be "kids messing around". "If this was a nation state, why affect only a subset of French fridges? There are plenty of other nations with fridges on the internet," he said. "No ransom or demand suggests a lack of appreciation of the potential commercial losses that the fridge owners may experience." PROBLEM STILL EXISTS Plenty of fridges remain reachable via the internet. Using the internet scanning service Shodan, Reuters found at least 4,500 Danfoss interfaces still viewable on Tuesday. Reuters could not independently establish how many of them were running vulnerable software, but French internet scanning company Onyphe said only a small minority of the devices appeared to be running the latest version of the software. Outdated and vulnerable versions were "still widely represented among publicly accessible interfaces", Onyphe said. DUTCH DISRUPTION Separately, Dutch retailer Ahold Delhaize [USN:S8N42D059 TEXT:"said on Tuesday"] that it had begun "starting a controlled re-launch of certain systems" following a cybersecurity issue that began on Sunday evening. The Dutch cybersecurity watchdog NCSC said it did not believe the incident was linked to the French supermarket hack. Ahold operates the Albert Heijn chain in the Netherlands and several major US chains including Stop & Shop and Giant Food. Websites for stores in both countries remained offline late Tuesday afternoon, with online ordering and delivery services unavailable.

item.title: Cirugía del papa León fue exitosa y se desarrolló según lo previsto, reporta el Vaticano
item.description: La intervención quirúrgica a la que se sometió el martes el papa León para extirpar un pequeño nódulo en uno de sus pulmones se desarrolló con éxito y según lo previsto, dijo el Vaticano, unas siete horas después de que el pontífice fuera ingresado en el hospital por el primer problema de salud grave de sus 17 meses de pontificado.
item.dc:creator: Joshua McElwee, Matteo Negri
item.content:encoded: La intervención quirúrgica a la que se sometió el martes el papa León para extirpar un pequeño nódulo en uno de sus pulmones se desarrolló con éxito y según lo previsto, dijo el Vaticano, unas siete horas después de que el pontífice fuera ingresado en el hospital por el primer problema de salud grave de sus 17 meses de pontificado. León, de 71 años, fue atendido en el hospital Gemelli de Roma para la extirpación del pequeño nódulo, que, según declaró el pontífice el domingo, se había detectado en una fase temprana durante un reciente chequeo médico. "La intervención se completó con éxito, dentro del plazo previsto y según lo planeado", indicó un breve comunicado del Vaticano emitido a última hora del martes, que no ofrecía más detalles. El Vaticano había informado anteriormente que la intervención fue dirigida por el jefe de cirugía torácica del Gemelli, el profesor Stefano Margaritora. León salió del Vaticano antes de la intervención, poco antes de las 1100 GMT en Roma, y se le vio saludando con la mano desde la parte trasera de un todoterreno negro mientras su comitiva recorría unos 9 km al norte del Vaticano hasta llegar al Gemelli. Al llegar al hospital, León estrechó la mano a varios funcionarios, pasó ante una multitud de simpatizantes que le esperaba —algunos de los cuales gritaban "Auguri" (mis mejores deseos)— y entró por la entrada principal. Según los expertos médicos, la intervención quirúrgica del martes debería ayudar a determinar si el tumor es maligno o qué tratamiento adicional es necesario. El Vaticano no especificó en su comunicado de la tarde qué pruebas se le habían realizado al nódulo. El Vaticano ha indicado que se espera que el papa se recupere en el hospital durante aproximadamente una semana. Se han cancelado todos sus actos públicos hasta el 20 de octubre. UN PAPA RELATIVAMENTE JOVEN León, elegido por los cardenales de todo el mundo en mayo de 2025, es relativamente joven para ser un líder de la Iglesia. Le gustan los deportes, incluido el tenis, y no se sabe que fume ni que haya tenido problemas de salud recientemente. Un nódulo pulmonar es una pequeña lesión localizada que puede ser benigna. La Sociedad Torácica Americana afirma que menos del 5% de los nódulos pulmonares resultan ser cancerosos, aunque el riesgo aumenta con la edad, el tamaño y otros factores como el tabaquismo. El doctor Federico Venuto, jefe de cirugía torácica del Hospital Policlínico Umberto I de Roma, explicó que las intervenciones para extirpar nódulos pulmonares suelen ser mínimamente invasivas y, en ocasiones, pueden implicar el uso de un tubo con cámara delgada denominado toracoscopio. "La tasa de complicaciones es extremadamente baja", declaró a Reuters. VIAJE A SUDAMÉRICA El difunto papa Francisco, predecesor de León, fue hospitalizado en varias ocasiones a medida que su salud se debilitaba en sus últimos años. Falleció a los 88 años en abril de 2025. León, que habló con voz firme y clara en su único acto público del lunes, mantiene una agenda muy apretada. Tiene previsto realizar una gira de 11 días por Uruguay, Argentina y Perú del 6 al 17 de noviembre. Someterse a la intervención quirúrgica sin demora le ofrece la mejor oportunidad de mantener su viaje por Sudamérica según lo previsto. La suite del Gemelli donde suelen alojarse los papas durante el tratamiento no está disponible actualmente porque se está renovando. El papa es la máxima autoridad terrenal para los 1.400 millones de católicos del mundo y no cuenta con un suplente que le sustituya cuando está enfermo. Cuando un pontífice se encuentra incapacitado, la actividad de la vasta burocracia del Vaticano continúa con normalidad, aplazándose aquellas decisiones que requieran la aprobación papal. FIEBRE TIFOIDEA León, nacido en Chicago en 1955 como Robert Prevost, ejerció durante décadas como misionero y obispo en Perú antes de convertirse en papa. En 1985, cuando era un joven sacerdote, contrajo la fiebre tifoidea en Chulucanas (Perú) y fue hospitalizado. Relató la experiencia en la única entrevista importante que concedió como papa, en un libro publicado por Penguin Perú. León dijo que el dolor era tan intenso que le pidió a Dios que le dejara morir antes que seguir sufriendo. Interpretó su supervivencia como una señal de Dios de que "te necesitamos aquí (en la Tierra)", afirmó. "Nunca miré atrás", afirmó León.

item.title: ウェルズ・ファーゴ、第3四半期利益は予想超え 純金利収入は届かず
item.description: [１３日 ロイター] - 米大手銀行ウェルズ・ファーゴが１３日発表した第３・四半期決算は、１株当たり利益が市場予想を上回...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ウェルズ・ファーゴ、第3四半期利益は予想超え　純金利収入は届かず 10/13 20:33 配信

ウェルズ・ファーゴのクレジットカード REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

[１３日 ロイター] - 米大手銀行ウェルズ・ファーゴが１３日発表した第３・四半期決算は、１株当たり利益が市場予想を上回ったものの、純金利収入と総収入は予想に届かなかった。

１株当たり利益は１．８７ドル。ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリストの平均予想の１．８５ドルを上回った。

純金利収入は５％増の１２５億２０００万ドルとなったが、市場予想の１２６億３０００万ドルには届かなかった。変動金利資産の適用金利低下や預金コストの上昇、無利息預金の減少が純金利収入に影響した。

２０２５年に１兆９５００億ドルの資産上限規制が解除されたことを受け、同行はバランスシートを拡大し、大手競合にシェアを奪われていた事業での巻き返しを図っている。

ただ融資残高の急拡大に伴い、将来の貸し倒れに備えた引当金も増加。同行は延滞動向に悪化は見られないとしている。

貸倒引当金繰入額は１０億３０００万ドルと、前年同期の６億８１００万ドルから増加した。

総収入は２１８億７０００万ドルとなり、市場予想の２２３億１０００万ドルを下回った。

ウェルズは良好な消費動向を取り込み、クレジットカードと自動車ローンを軸に個人向け融資残高を拡大してきた。

チャーリー・シャーフ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は声明で「経済の先行きは不透明で消費者心理もまちまちだが、当行のデータを見る限り個人・法人顧客の状況はいずれも良好だ」と述べた。

マイク・サントマッシモ最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は決算発表後の電話会見で「借り手にも預金者にも、これまで見られた基調に変化が生じていると思わせるような行動の変化は見られない」と述べた。

＜投資銀行業務はまちまち＞

同行は投資銀行・市場部門に多額の資金を投じており、幹部級のバンカーを採用するとともに、顧客向け融資やトレーディング、その他の資本市場業務への支出を増やしている。

この戦略により、同行は投資銀行業務のランキングで順位を上げ、ネクステラ・エナジーによる同業ドミニオン・エナジーの６７０億ドルでの買収など、２０２６年の大型案件の一部で助言業務を獲得した。第３・四半期には、トーマ・ブラボーによるアクセララントの４０億ドル超での非公開化で助言を担った。

第３・四半期の投資銀行業務収入は前年同期比１０％増の６億１１００万ドルだった。ただ借り入れコストの上昇が重しとなり、前四半期比では３％減少した。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める アングル：ドル高支える年金基金のヘッジ巻き戻し、市場環境変化で懸念後退 アングル：今年はバリュー投資が活発化か、ＡＩバブル懸念で着目点変化 アングル：米株のテック依存、「ＩＴバブル期」上回る　市場を不安定に アングル：米国株、人気は株主還元よりＡＩ技術革新投資の企業 最終更新: 10/13(火) 22:08 ロイター

item.description: THE HAGUE: Nobel Peace Prize winner Navi Pillay urged the United States on Tuesday (Oct 13) to return to its traditional role of defender of human rights and liberator for the rest of the world amid a
item.dc:creator: CNA

Nobel peace laureate Navi Pillay urges US to defend human rights

Nobel Peace Prize laureate Navi Pillay speaks during an interview with Reuters in The Hague, Netherlands on Oct 13, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Piroschka van de Wouw)

FAST

THE HAGUE: Nobel Peace Prize winner Navi Pillay urged the United States on Tuesday (Oct 13) to return to its traditional role of defender of human rights and liberator for the rest of the world amid a US campaign to undermine the International Criminal Court.  "My message is: 'You have to get back to playing your serious role as a leader, playing a liberatory role for the rest of the world'," Pillay, 85, told Reuters in The Hague, where she is currently a judge at the United Nations' highest legal body, the International Court of Justice.   Hours after Pillay was announced as the winner of the Peace Prize on Friday, the United States announced sweeping sanctions aimed at her former employer, the International Criminal Court.  She said the timing of the sanctions, an unprecedented attack on an institution founded by international treaty, right after her Nobel Prize win could not be coincidental.

"I think it's very unfortunate. However, the plans of targeting international criminal justice through the ICC were brewing all the time," Pillay said. "That's why the first thing I did when I returned from Nuremberg to The Hague is to go to the staff of the ICC to show solidarity for their work in promoting international criminal justice and to protect those who've already been sanctioned." US Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Friday called the ICC a "rogue court" that would never be allowed to prosecute Americans. The new sanctions were suspended for six months, and included some other exemptions for transactions for telecoms, software, payment of pensions and transactions related to detainees. The US has long been hostile to the court, and especially the ICC statute that says it has jurisdiction not only over nationals of member states but also over others alleged to have committed atrocity crimes on the territory of member states.

item.title: 機関投資家、米10年債6％近くなら株から資金移動＝ＢｏＦＡ調査
item.description: ［ロンドン １３日 ロイター］ - 投資家が株式から債券に資金を移すほど債券の魅力が高まるには、米１０年債利回りが６％...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
機関投資家、米10年債6％近くなら株から資金移動＝ＢｏＦＡ調査 10/13 20:27 配信

ドル紙幣 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

［ロンドン　１３日　ロイター］ - 投資家が株式から債券に資金を移すほど債券の魅力が高まるには、米１０年債利回りが６％近くまで上昇する必要があることが、米バンク・オブ・アメリカ（ＢｏＦＡ）が１３日公表した１０月の世界ファンドマネジャー調査で分かった。金利が大きく上昇する中でも、株式市場の底堅さを保っていることが背景にある。

調査は１０月２─８日に実施した。投資家の楽観度は６月以来の低さとなったが、米中間選挙と第３・四半期の決算シーズンに向けて、マクロ経済と市場については依然として強気な見方を維持した。

１０月調査の主な結果は以下の通り。

・世界経済の成長見通しについて悲観的な見方に転じた。今後１２カ月で景気が悪化すると予想する割合は差し引きで４％。インフレ期待は２０２５年１月以来の低水準に下がった。

・債券利回りに対する悲観的な見方は２５年５月以来の低水準。長期金利の上昇を予想する割合は差し引き１％と、９月の１５％から低下。

・市場にとって最大のテールリスクは債券利回りの無秩序な上昇。次いで人工知能（ＡＩ）バブル。

・最も活発だった取引は引き続き「世界の半導体株の買い持ち」で、次いで「米国債の売り持ち」。

・ＡＩハイパースケーラー（大規模クラウド事業者）の設備投資は、システミックな信用イベントの最も可能性の高い発生源と引き続き見なされている。

・ハイテク株のオーバーウエートは２０年８月以来の高水準。一般消費財株のアンダーウエートは０８年７月以来の高水準。

・銀行株への配分は、２３年３月以来の大幅な減少。

・配分が増えたのは債券、日本株、英国株、公益株。

・配分が減ったのは銀行株、米国株、一般消費財株。

・投資家の７６％が、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は１０月に政策金利を据え置くと予想。

item.title: Trump says he does not believe China and Russia are helping Iran at all
item.description: Trump says Moscow and Beijing have too much to lose by helping Tehran, amid reports of possible Russian targeting support and Chinese assistance during the Iran war ...
item.content:encoded:
Home / World News / Trump says he does not believe China and Russia are helping Iran at all

Trump says he does not believe China and Russia are helping Iran at all Trump says Moscow and Beijing have too much to lose by helping Tehran, amid reports of possible Russian targeting support and Chinese assistance during the Iran war

President Donald Trump (Photo:PTI)

Reuters Washington 3 min read Last Updated : Oct 13 2026 | 11:42 PM IST

Listen to This Article

President Donald Trump said late on Monday he did not believe that China and Russia were helping Iran "at all," adding that Moscow and Beijing had "too much to lose" if they enabled Tehran.   Trump said on Truth Social that he had seen comments from his critics and opponents that China and Russia were helping Iran.   "If they are, it's at a very low level, but I don't believe they are at all. They have too much to lose, and we would know about it, and know about it very fast," Trump wrote.   Trump said in July he trusted China and Russia not to help Tehran in the Iran war, but warned that if they did get involved, "it would be very bad for them."

The United States and Iran have been at war since February 28, when the US and Israel attacked Iran and Tehran responded with its own strikes on Israel and Gulf states that host US bases. US-Israeli strikes on Iran and Israeli attacks on Lebanon have since killed thousands and displaced millions. Also Read

India rejects China's objection to standard names for 28 Ladakh places

China opposes India's move to name 28 strategic locations in Ladakh

Visa gets approval to prepare for domestic payments business in China

Trump's diesel deal with Russia irks allies, unlikely to reduce prices

Trump's deal with Russia gives Putin a boost in economic war with Ukraine

Trump has previously described Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin as "neutral" during the Iran war.   Iranian drone attacks on CIA facilities in the Gulf have prompted US intelligence analysts to investigate whether Russia provided targeting information or advanced drone technology.   European foreign ministers pressed the case in a March meeting with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio. The Washington Post and The Wall Street Journal reported that month that Russia was providing Iran with targeting information.

Moscow and Beijing maintain close ties with Tehran. Russia has said the Iran war could lead to a nuclear arms race in West Asia. Beijing has condemned Washington's attacks on Tehran as a brazen violation of Iran's sovereignty.   Last month, Trump warned Xi against providing support to Iran when the Chinese leader visited Washington, and received assurances that China would not do so, the US ambassador to China said at the time.   The warning came amid reports that China had supplied Iran with shoulder-fired air-defence missile launchers and that Tehran had found ways to evade sanctions on its oil sales with Chinese help.

In September, Trump brushed aside a report that Iran acquired satellite images of a base in Jordan from Chinese entities before an attack that killed three US troops there in July.

item.title: グレタさん、仏生徒のデモに参加 「世界中が見守っている」
item.description:
Janis Laizans Clotaire Achi
[サンドニ（フランス） １３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Janis Laizans　Clotaire Achi

[サンドニ（フランス） １３日 ロイター] - スウェーデンの活動家グレタ・トゥンベリさんは１３日、パリ郊外の労働者が多く住む地区の高校前で、生徒らのデモに参加した。

パリなど各都市では午前中、生徒らが複数の学校の校門前に集まり、プラカードや拡声器を手にスローガンを叫んだ。この日はデモ行進も予定されている。

ジェフレ国民教育相はラジオ局フランス・アンテルに対し、約２００校が休校になったと述べた。一部は予定されているデモ行進の経路上にあるため、安全上の予防措置として休校にした可能性を示唆した。

グレタさんはフランスの生徒らにはもっと幅広い支援が寄せられるべきだと述べた。パリ北郊サンドニの高校前で記者団に「世界中の人々がこの動きを見守っていることを知ってほしい。基本的な権利を求める若者たちに私たちは勇気づけられている」と語った。

「学校の資金不足であれ、気候危機であれ、社会的不公正を巡る危機であれ、今こそ若者が立ち上がり、自分たちの未来を取り戻す時だ」と訴えた。

激しい議論を呼んでいる警察の対応について「極めて暴力的」だと批判した。当局が既存の体制を守り、若者の要求を無視していることの表れだと述べた。

item.title: Allies gave Ukraine no warning of impending missile attack, Zelenskiy says
item.description: Ukraine received no warning from Western partners before a Russian missile attack on its capital, President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Tuesday, but President Donald Trump said Washington was still sharing intelligence even as he pressured Kyiv to halt attacks on Russian refineries.
item.dc:creator: Olena Harmash, Daniel Flynn
item.content:encoded: Ukraine received no warning from Western partners before a Russian missile attack on its capital, President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Tuesday, but President Donald Trump said Washington was still sharing intelligence even as he pressured Kyiv to halt attacks on Russian refineries. Russia hit no Ukrainian energy targets overnight for the first time since Trump's surprise Sunday announcement of an "energy ceasefire", but hammered transport and logistics with ballistic missiles and drones. Reuters and other media have reported that US officials have threatened to cut off intelligence sharing and weapons sales to Ukraine unless it stops attacking Russian refineries. Kyiv relies heavily on US intelligence for early warnings of missile strikes, experts and officials say. Speaking to reporters on Tuesday, Trump said Washington [USN:L1N45Z0QL TEXT:"continued to share intelligence with Ukraine"] and was working with both Kyiv and Moscow to end the war. "We are helping them, and we are sharing intel," he said. Trump was asked whether Russia had violated the ceasefire and answered: "I'll let you know about that later." Asked if Russia could use proceeds from the diesel deal to purchase more bombs, Trump sidestepped the question. "That's a diesel deal, not for us. That's being released into the world. That's not being released to us." Zelenskiy said Ukraine had not targeted Russian refineries since Trump's announcement on Sunday. He said Kyiv had not received the usual warning from allies of ballistic missile launches before a "particularly vile" attack on Kyiv overnight, in which five missiles hit civilian infrastructure. "Intelligence on Russian ballistic missile launches helps save lives," Zelenskiy said on X, "and this is one of the most critical issues." He stopped short of linking the lack of warning to any US threats. AIR RAID ALERTS SOUND IN KYIV ONLY AFTER BLASTS ARE HEARD Air alerts sounded in Kyiv on Monday night only after several explosions had already ripped through the city. Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said Ukraine was still receiving US military intelligence and attributed the delay to the type of weapon Russia had used. As Ukraine fights a larger, richer and better-equipped enemy, Kyiv sees the strikes on Russian oil refineries as one of its few instruments to reduce Moscow's ability to fight. Yet Trump has repeatedly blamed Ukrainian attacks – which prompted Moscow to suspend [USN:L1N45Y0OS TEXT:"diesel exports"] – for a sharp rise in US fuel prices this year, a headache for his Republican Party ahead of congressional midterm elections in three weeks. Most analysts say the US war in Iran has had a far greater impact on the price rise. Russia had struck six Ukrainian energy sites on Monday. It was unclear whether Moscow had deliberately avoided energy infrastructure overnight and on Tuesday. A Kremlin spokesman, asked about the energy ceasefire, would only say that contacts were ongoing, but declined to provide any further details. In his nightly video address posted on X, Zelenskiy said he had sent proposals to US officials with a view to new meetings in coming days with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner on ways to resolve the conflict. He said Ukraine supported Trump's announcement of an energy truce provided that Russia observed it. "We need to work for peace, we need to look for ways to do the proper actions. Ukraine is ready for meetings," he said. Earlier, Zelenskiy reiterated Ukraine's position, saying that Kyiv was ready for reciprocal steps to de-escalate, calling on partners to pressure Russia. A Ukrainian delegation held talks in the United States last week and people familiar with the meeting said Witkoff and Kushner [USN:L1N45Y0OS TEXT:"told"] them that a deal to allow Russian diesel exports was part of a bid to draw Russia back to negotiations. UKRAINE SAYS IT NOW HAS CARDS TO PLAY Russian strikes also killed four people in Ukraine's second city, Kharkiv, and dozens were wounded across the country, Ukrainian officials said. Fabian Hoffmann, a missile expert at the Norwegian Institute for Defence Studies, said Ukraine's European allies had "very limited" ability to replace US early-warning intelligence about Russian missile strikes. "Ukraine relies on the so-called Space-Based Infrared System which the US deploys – and the US system is really second to none and only the United States can provide that," he said. Sybiha said the US request to halt attacks on Russian refineries showed how Ukraine's position had strengthened, alluding to Trump's comment to Zelenskiy in a tense Oval Office meeting last year that "you don't have the cards". "In less than two years, we have gone from 'having no cards' to 'not playing your cards'. That is an achievement," Sybiha said.

item.title: IMF projects 7 pc growth for India, Piyush Goyal hails forecast
item.description: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) on Tuesday projected India's economy to grow by 7 per cent in both FY27 and FY28, while warning of a fragile global economic outlook, rising inflation, ...
item.content:encoded:
IMF projects 7 pc growth for India, Piyush Goyal hails forecast The International Monetary Fund (IMF) on Tuesday projected India's economy to grow by 7 per cent in both FY27 and FY28, while warning of a fragile global economic outlook, rising inflation, geopolitical uncertainties and mounting fiscal pressures across major economies. ANI | Updated: 13-10-2026 23:05 IST | Created: 13-10-2026 23:05 IST

Representative image (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

The International Monetary Fund (IMF) on Tuesday projected India's economy to grow by 7 per cent in both FY27 and FY28, while warning of a fragile global economic outlook, rising inflation, geopolitical uncertainties and mounting fiscal pressures across major economies. The projection, released in the IMF's October 2026 World Economic Outlook, was welcomed by Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal, who said India's free trade agreements (FTAs) would further strengthen global economic activity and resilient supply chains. The IMF projected global growth to slow from 3.5 per cent in 2025 to 3.1 per cent in 2026 before recovering to 3.4 per cent in 2027. “The global economy remains resilient, but that resilience is becoming more fragile and more uneven,” the Fund said. India, however, is expected to remain among the fastest-growing major economies, supported by stronger-than-expected economic momentum, resilient domestic demand and robust services activity. Reacting to the forecast, Goyal said in a post on X, “UNSTOPPABLE INDIA! IMF has projected a 7% GDP growth for 2027 for Bharat, making us among the fastest growing major economies. Our multiple FTAs under PM @NarendraModi ji are also expected to positively contribute to global economic activity and build resilient supply chains.” On global inflation, the IMF projected an increase to 4.7 per cent in 2026, driven by higher energy and food prices, before easing to 4.1 per cent in 2027. It warned that prolonged conflict or further escalation in the Middle East could keep commodity prices elevated, revive inflationary pressures and weaken economic growth. “Risks are skewed to the downside,” the report said. The IMF also cautioned that global trade growth could slow amid tariffs, supply-chain adjustments and geopolitical disruptions, despite support from technology-related investment and trade. It flagged the possibility of a sharp reassessment of artificial intelligence-related investment returns, which could trigger equity market corrections and tighten financial conditions. Separately, the Fund raised concerns over deteriorating fiscal conditions, noting that public debt remained elevated and fiscal deficits in several major economies were significantly higher than before the COVID-19 pandemic. Rising borrowing costs, alongside spending pressures related to ageing populations, climate change and national security, have further reduced governments' ability to respond to fresh economic shocks. The IMF called for “strong and deliberate actions” to rebuild fiscal buffers and strengthen resilience, warning that the room for policy adjustments was narrowing. While India's growth outlook remains relatively strong, the Fund's broader assessment highlighted increasing vulnerabilities in the global economy from persistent geopolitical tensions, inflationary pressures and limited fiscal space. Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis also hailed the forecast made by IMF. "India Defies the Odds! The International Monetary Fund’s (IMF) October 2026 World Economic Outlook projects India’s economy to grow by 7.0% in both 2026 and 2027, making us among the fastest growing major economies. Under the visionary leadership of Hon PM Narendra Modi Ji, India continues to emerge as a driving force of global growth despite ongoing global economic uncertainties," he wrote on X. Union Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat also hailed the projections. "Under the visionary leadership of Hon’ble PM Shri @narendramodi ji, India continues to demonstrate remarkable economic resilience and strong growth momentum amid global uncertainty. The IMF projects India’s GDP to grow at 7.0% in both 2026 and 2027, even as global growth is projected at 3.1% in 2026 amid rising inflationary pressures. This reflects India’s growing economic strength and its expanding role in the global economy. India continues to advance towards a Viksit Bharat, driven by reforms, investment and sustained economic growth under Hon’ble PM Modi ji’s leadership," he said. Keralam BJP president Rajeev Chandrasekhar said the projections are a result of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's "incredibly deft management of the economy". "India's economy has never been stronger and more resilient. Today the IMF has upgraded India's growth forecast to 7% for 2026-27, far outpacing the fragile global average of 3.1% This is no accident. It is the direct result of PM @narendramodi ji's incredibly deft management of the economy during the pandemic, the biggest challenge of his 25 years in governance. We rightly thank him for how he managed the Covid health crisis. Not many understand how incredibly well he also handled the economic challenge, steering India through the storm and to calmer seas. Since Covid, almost every major economy has seen its public finances worsen," he said. Slamming the opposition, Chandrasekhar added, "India is one of the few whose finances and economic activity are back near pre-Covid levels. No other major economy, not the USA, not China, not Europe, is where India is While the opposition stays fully invested in creating chaos and anarchy at home, the Modi government continues to build a stronger, more resilient India. Meanwhile, spare a thought (or not) for the political frauds who called India's economy dead. These types of results are beyond the comprehension of lazy, clueless, inept, entitled, dynastic leaders and their cronies." (ANI)

(This story has not been edited by Devdiscourse staff and is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Canada's main stock index rose on Tuesday, lifted by energy shares, while a global semiconductor selloff amid renewed AI concerns drove investors into government bonds, helping stabilize yields. The S&P/TSX Composite Index (.GSPTSE) closed up 0.90%, at 35,983.98. Energy shares (.SPTTEN) led gains despite lower oil prices Natural gas solution firm Enerflex (EFX.TO) jumped 14% after securing a major data-centre power project that lifted its behind-the-meter generation backlog above 1.75 GW through 2028 Materials (.GSPTTMT) fell 1.84% as silver dropped more than 1%, while gold was little changed Canada's 10-year government bond yield slipped to 3.871%, while the comparable US 10-year yield slipped to 5.2126% "There's perhaps a sense in the markets that bond yields have peaked short term and that seems to be driving the market more than anything else," said Matt Skipp, president at SW8 Asset Management TSX's financial stocks (.SPTTFS) added 1.4% after major US banks reported results. Investors have been grappling with inflation concerns lately tied to higher energy prices and rising government debt Global semiconductor shares were pressured by reports that Chinese memory-chip maker CXMT has made rapid advances, raising concerns that China is narrowing the technology gap Canada's technology sector nevertheless rose about 1.6%, helped by a 3% gain in Shopify (SHOP.TO) Markets are pricing in at least one more 25-basis-point Federal Reserve rate hike by year-end, according to LSEG data In Canada, the TSX posted its biggest weekly gain in five weeks on Friday after [USN:L1N45V0EG TEXT:"soft jobs data"] reduced expectations of another Bank of Canada rate increase Markets are now seeing a 28% chance of a hike at this month's meeting

item.title: アジアでヘッジファンド投資拡大、「債券4割」の分散効果に疑問
item.description:
Summer Zhen Tom Westbrook
［香港 １３日 ロイター］ - アジアでヘッジファンド投資が拡大し...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アジアでヘッジファンド投資拡大、「債券4割」の分散効果に疑問 10/13 19:29 配信

香港の金融街で2023年10月撮影 REUTERS/Tyrone Siu/File Photo

Summer Zhen　Tom Westbrook

［香港　１３日　ロイター］ - アジアでヘッジファンド投資が拡大している。年金基金やファミリーオフィスなどの投資家が、債券や株式の不安定な動きを受けてオルタナティブ（代替）資産に目を向けている。背景には、株式に６割、債券に４割を配分する「６０／４０」という投資の標準的なリスク管理戦略に疑問が生じていることがある。

ヘッジファンド・リサーチ（ＨＦＲ）のデータによると、２０２６年第２・四半期の世界のヘッジファンド運用資産は５兆６０００億ドル。四半期ベースで過去最大となる４０９０億ドルの伸びだった。運用成績も比較的堅調だ。ＨＦＲが算出する世界のヘッジファンド指数は年初来で７％上昇。２５年は１２．４％上昇した。

スイスのプライベートバンク、ＵＢＰによると、アジアで一任運用サービスを利用する顧客のうち、ヘッジファンドだけに投資するマンデート（運用委託）の比率は２４年末から３倍超に増えた。アジア一任運用部門責任者、パラス・グプタ氏は「米国債などの国債は、ここ数年で分散投資の手段としての信頼性が下がった」と述べ、その結果、ポートフォリオの中でヘッジファンドが果たせる役割が広がったと説明した。

戦略アドバイザーのマーシュのグローバル最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）、ニール・オサリバン氏によると、これまでヘッジファンドに投資していなかった一部機関投資家が、現在は約１０％の配分を望んでいる。特に、市場全体との相関が低いマルチストラテジー型ファンドが人気という。

マーシュ・アジアの投資責任者、アデリン・タン氏は、ウェルスマネジャーやファミリーオフィスのほか、日本の確定給付型年金などの大口機関投資家からも関心が寄せられていると話した。

ＪＰモルガン・プライベートバンクのアジア・オルタナティブ投資責任者、アルバート・ヤン氏は、ＡＩへの集中リスクが意識されていると指摘し、ヘッジファンドを変動に対応するための長期的な投資先とする例が増えていると述べた。

ただ、ヘッジファンド業界の中でも運用成績や資金の流れには大きなばらつきがある。ヤン氏は、ヘッジファンドへのシフトは伝統的なポートフォリオに取って代わるものではなく、新しい戦略と耐久力を補強する意味合いがあると述べた。

機動的で、株式市場の方向性に関係なくリターンを生み出せるマルチストラテジー型、マクロ型、クオンツ型などの運用会社が、特に大きな恩恵を受けている。

item.title: Nasdaq ends down as chipmakers fall and bank earnings roll in
item.description: The Nasdaq ended lower on Tuesday, as chip stocks added to recent losses and investors parsed mixed quarterly results from Citigroup and other big US banks.
item.dc:creator: Noel Randewich
item.content:encoded: The Nasdaq ended lower on Tuesday, as chip stocks added to recent losses and investors parsed mixed quarterly results from Citigroup and other big US banks. The PHLX chip index (.SOX) fell 0.23%, down for a fifth straight session, after Broadcom (AVGO.O) CEO Hock Tan on Monday [USN:L1N45Z07U TEXT:"likened"] some of the investment flow into the sector to "casino gambling." Additionally, reports of technological advances by Chinese memory chip company CXMT underscored concerns about rising competition. Micron Technology (MU.O) lost 3.6% and Applied Materials (AMAT.O) dropped almost 7%. Broadcom rose 0.7%. [USN:L4N45Z14U TEXT:"Citigroup"] (C.N) dipped 5.6% and [USN:L4N45Z111 TEXT:"Goldman Sachs"] (GS.N) lost 0.2% after both banks topped profit estimates. Wells Fargo (WFC.N) fell 3.1% after its [USN:L4N45Z0VX TEXT:"net interest income"] missed estimates, while JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) ended down 0.9% following a [USN:L4N45Z10B TEXT:"rare profit miss"]. Apple (AAPL.O) hit an intraday record high of $348.15 before closing up 0.1% at $341.27, putting its stock market value at $4.98 trillion. Analysts on average see S&P 500 third-quarter earnings surging over 30%, fueled largely by AI-related technology companies, according to LSEG data. Expectations of a [USN:L6N45T17Q TEXT:"strong earnings season"] have offset worries about the US war with Iran, surging bond yields and inflation related to high oil prices. "A lot of investors are feeling a sense of relief that markets might start looking at earnings and less at the bond market, less at higher-for-longer oil prices and less at high interest rates," said Jake Dollarhide, CEO of Longbow Asset Management in Tulsa, Oklahoma. The S&P 500 declined 0.02% to end the session at 7,805.45 points. The Nasdaq declined 0.15% to 27,204.38 points, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average declined 0.35% to 51,670.10 points. The S&P 500 has rallied 14% in 2026, lifted by AI-related technology stocks. However, the [USN:L6N45T156 TEXT:"median stock"] in the index is up less than 5% and over 200 S&P 500 components are down for the year. Reflecting expectations of strong corporate earnings from AI heavyweights, the S&P 500 is trading at under 19 times expected earnings, its lowest since 2023. The PHLX chip index has lost more than 8% in the past five sessions and it remains up over 70% year-to-date. The S&P 500 healthcare index (.SPXHC) fell 1.3% on Tuesday, with [USN:L1N45Y0R3 TEXT:"Johnson & Johnson"] (JNJ.N) down 5.7% despite topping profit estimates. Bumble (BMBL.O) jumped almost 57% after [USN:L4N45Z17G TEXT:"the dating-app operator"] agreed to go private in a $1.3 billion deal. Domino's Pizza (DPZ.O) declined 4.8% after scaling back its full-year sales outlook. Advancing issues outnumbered falling ones within the S&P 500 (.AD.SPX) by a 1.1-to-one ratio. The S&P 500 posted 18 new highs and five new lows; the Nasdaq recorded 47 new highs and 408 new lows. Volume on US exchanges was relatively light, with 14.8 billion shares traded, compared with an average of 17.6 billion shares over the previous 20 sessions.

item.title: 英キャピタルゲイン税、所得税並みへの引き上げ見送りへ＝ＦＴ
item.description: [ロンドン １３日 ロイター] - 英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）は１３日、関係者４人の話として、ヒーリー英財務...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英キャピタルゲイン税、所得税並みへの引き上げ見送りへ＝ＦＴ 10/13 19:19 配信

演説するヒーリー英財務相、9月28日撮影 REUTERS/Phil Noble

[ロンドン １３日 ロイター] - 英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）は１３日、関係者４人の話として、ヒーリー英財務相がキャピタルゲイン税率を所得税率と同水準まで引き上げることはないと報じた。２８日に公表される政府予算案で、こうした税制変更が打ち出されるとの臆測が出ていた。

ヒーリー氏は初の予算案で、数十億ポンド規模の税収確保を迫られている。借り入れコストの上昇を補い、バーナム首相が掲げる国防費の増額や社会福祉サービス拡充の財源を賄うためだ。

ＦＴによると、ヒーリー氏がキャピタルゲイン税の引き上げ幅を抑えた上で増税する可能性はなお残っている。現在のキャピタルゲイン税率は、所得税の基本税率が適用される納税者が１８％、高税率が適用される納税者が２４％。所得税率はそれぞれ２０％、４０％となっている。

ヒーリー氏は所得税、付加価値税、法人税、社会保険料の税率・料率を引き上げないとした労働党の２０２４年の政権公約を守ると約束しており、選択肢は限られている。

２０２５─２６年度のキャピタルゲイン税収は２４０億ポンド（３１８億ドル）だった。ただエコノミストらは、税率を引き上げると資産売却を見送ったり、英国を離れたりする人が増えるといった行動の変化が生じ、税収が減る恐れがあると警告している。

item.title: アンソロピックとオープンＡＩ、外部評価の公表に管理権限要求＝関係筋
item.description:
Aditya Soni
[ニューヨーク １３日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックとオープンＡＩ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アンソロピックとオープンＡＩ、外部評価の公表に管理権限要求＝関係筋 10/13 19:08 配信

アンソロピックとオープンＡＩのそれぞれのロゴ。6月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Aditya Soni

[ニューヨーク １３日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックとオープンＡＩは、ＡＩモデルのリスクを評価する外部機関が公表する内容について、大きな管理権限を求めている。関係者２人が明らかにした。評価結果から企業秘密が明らかになることを懸念しているという。

関係者によると、社内に常駐して評価作業を行う外部機関の職員が、独自情報をライバル企業に持ち出すことを両社は懸念している。

このため、知的財産の流出防止策として、常駐する評価チームの作業にＡＩ開発企業の社員を立ち会わせることや、ある開発企業に常駐する評価機関が同時に別の開発企業で業務を行うことを禁じることなどが協議されているという。

ただ別の関係者は、企業側が重要な知的財産とみなす情報がモデルのリスク評価に関わる情報と重なる場合があり、対立が起きたり報告書の一部が削除されたりする可能性があると述べた。

専門家からは、アンソロピックとオープンＡＩが評価を担う機関を選んでいるため、評価機関の独立性に懸念があるとの指摘が出ている。

一部の専門家は、独立した評価について合意された基準や法律がなければ、最も強力なＡＩモデルを開発する企業が評価方法を一方的に決め、評価機関は企業側の意向に従わざるを得なくなる恐れがあると述べた。

アンソロピックはロイターの質問に対し、常駐する評価機関の公表内容について大きな管理権限を求めているとの指摘は、独立した評価機関との協議や取り組み全体を正確に表していないと回答した。

過去に協力した評価機関との現在の協議では、評価の手法や基準、結論、公表内容を決める権限は外部評価機関にあると明確に伝えていると説明した。一方、新たに協力する評価機関が同社のモデルの仕組みを学び、協力関係を築いていく間は、報告書に意見を述べ、承認する権利を留保しているとした。

オープンＡＩは、評価機関が作成する報告書の全文について承認権を求めているわけではないと述べた。機密情報を削除するのが通常の対応であり、評価機関は大幅な削除があったかどうかを開示できるとした。

ロイターが確認した契約書によると、ＡＩ開発企業がモデルの評価会社との一部契約で既に用いている条項は、企業側の同意なく報告書で機密情報を公表することを禁じ得る内容となっている。

＜報告書の一部削除＞

オープンＡＩの高度なモデルを搭載した自律型エージェントが暴走し、ハギング・フェイスにサイバー攻撃を行った問題では、モデル・エバリュエーション・アンド・スレット・リサーチ（ＭＥＴＲ）とレッドウッド・リサーチがまとめた報告書から、オープンＡＩが非公開情報を削除した。

ＭＥＴＲとレッドウッドは、オープンＡＩの意見を踏まえ、報告書の構成、強調点、分かりやすさ、論調を修正したが、それ以外に結論にとって重要な内容は削除されていないと強調した。

両団体はオープンＡＩが最終的に認めたアクセスを評価した。一方、報告書の執筆や編集、一部削除に関する判断では、重大な事案の後に開発企業が外部評価機関の受け入れをためらうようになるリスクを考慮したと述べた。

item.description:
Kentaro Okasaka
[東京 １３日 ロイター] - キオクシアホールディングスは１３日、 Ｓ＆Ｐグローバ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
キオクシアＨＤ、Ｓ＆Ｐ格付け「ＢＢＢ」に　収益力評価で格上げ 10/13 19:02 配信

キオクシアのロゴ。都内で9月撮影。 REUTERS/Issei Kato

Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 １３日 ロイター] - キオクシアホールディングスは１３日、 Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・レーティングから取得している長期発行体格付けが「ＢＢＢ」へ格上げされたと発表した。格付け見通しは「ポジティブ」。

キオクシアＨＤは、ＡＩ向けデータセンター市場がフラッシュメモリーなどの需要拡大をけん引する中、自社の収益力が非常に強い水準で推移すると評価されたとしている。また、現預金が有利子負債を上回るネットキャッシュ状態を実現した財務体質の改善も評価されたとした。

キオクシアＨＤは「引き続き持続的な企業価値向上に向け、成長戦略と財務健全性の両立に取り組む」としている。

item.title: Bank of America loses bankers, tells staff of big ambition, continued hiring
item.description: Bank of America's top leaders had a problem in the first week of August. Veteran banker Amy Lissauer — one of the company's most senior female executives — was considering jumping to rival JPMorgan Chase , people familiar with the matter said.
item.dc:creator: Svea Herbst-Bayliss, Saeed Azhar, Milana Vinn
item.content:encoded: Bank of America's (BAC.N) top leaders had a problem in the first week of August. Veteran banker Amy Lissauer — one of the company's most senior female executives — was considering jumping to rival JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) , people familiar with the matter said. Ultimately, the attempts by CEO Brian Moynihan and Faiz Ahmad, the co-head of global investment banking, to persuade Lissauer to stay were unsuccessful, the people added. But her departure, following the loss of several other prominent dealmakers over the past year, rattled staff to the point where executives felt they had to respond, people familiar with the bank said. Executive turnover is a fact of life on Wall Street, and banks routinely lose veteran dealmakers. But the losses, including three announced departures during the week of August 5, prompted BofA executives to reach out to staff to try to contain possible fallout. The outreach underscored executives' concerns that a steady loss of senior rainmakers during a capital-markets boom could hurt morale and reinforce perceptions that the nation’s second-largest bank had fallen behind its rivals in investment banking, the people familiar with the matter said. “We have strong momentum across our global business and represent clients in a lead advisory role in numerous industry defining transactions," a BofA spokesperson said in a statement to Reuters. "We have recruited dozens of senior bankers this year from our major competitors, reflecting the strength of our platform and the breadth of solutions to serve clients across the US and around the world." COMPETITION INTENSIFIES Bankers at rival Wall Street institutions have described BofA's banking staff as formidable competitors for merger deals and clients. But the bank ranks fourth on the Dealogic global league table for investment banking fees in 2025 and 2026, after the AI boom vaulted Morgan Stanley (MS.N) past BofA into third place, data and analytics company Dealogic said. In 2022, 2023 and 2024, Bank of America claimed the third spot behind JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs (GS.N) and ahead of Morgan Stanley, Dealogic said. BofA noted it is a market leader in AI-related capital market financings, with Dealogic reporting that the bank has been the book runner for $818 billion of issuance volume since January 2026, representing 59% of total AI-related capital raised across investment grade debt, leverage finance and equity capital markets. Meanwhile, a steady stream of departures over the past year has drawn attention. In late 2025, technology dealmaker Kevin Brunner, known for cultivating strong ties to software company Salesforce (CRM.N) for over a quarter of a century at the bank, said he would join JPMorgan. David Fishman, who was Bank of America’s co-head of technology, media and telecom M&A and a 16-year veteran, will join JPMorgan later this year. The week Lissauer departed, co-head of global investment banking Mike Joo and tech banker Ed Liu also left. Lissauer's loss in particular was notable, as she was recognized as a leader in defending corporate clients against activist investors who seek managerial and strategic overhauls. And JPMorgan Chase, the largest bank in the US, had wanted to poach her for years, executives familiar with the bank's thinking said — and the company quickly publicized the hiring. Keeping Lissauer was a priority at BofA, but a person familiar with the matter said her proposed package from JPMorgan was one BofA felt it could not match. EXECUTIVES MOVE TO REASSURE STAFF As word of the departures from early August spread, Ahmad, who was co-head of investment banking with Joo before his departure, sought to reassure staff at an August 10 meeting, said people who received the invitation to the in-person meeting. More than 50 people, including vice presidents and directors, were encouraged to join the meeting in a conference room in the bank's Midtown Manhattan office building to discuss changes in the mergers and acquisitions group, people who received invitations said. Ahmad was joined at the event by other top bankers, including the chairmen of global M&A, Steven Baronoff and Patrick Ramsey. Participants described executives promising that the bank is fully committed to climbing in the league tables, the competitive rankings that sort Wall Street banks, law firms, analysts and others by deal volume and transaction fees collected. One person said Bank of America is aiming for the top of the league tables and that the bank is hiring more senior bankers with a particular focus on technology. "All of our investment banking groups have regularly scheduled weekly meetings to discuss topical matters and the market environment," the bank spokesperson said in the statement. Matthew Koder, president of BofA's global corporate and investment banking unit, reinforced the message in an internal memo in August. Bank of America posted its second-highest investment banking fees ever in the first half of the year. Advisory and debt issuance fees were the highest for any first half since 2009. "We continue to invest in outstanding talent at every level and are pleased to have welcomed more than 40 new managing directors" to the corporate and investment bank this year, Koder wrote, according to a copy of the memo reviewed by Reuters. Bank of America senior hires this year have included veteran technology bankers Jason Rowe, Gary Kirkham and Richard Hardegree, and Bryce Dakin, who will join later this year. The bank also hired industrials banker George Murphy and Alban de La Sablière as vice chair of healthcare dealmaking in Europe, Middle East and Africa. "Our senior managing director hires have outpaced departures," the BofA spokesperson said. COMPENSATION WORRIES EMERGE But bankers told Reuters they worried about the thinning out of the coverage bankers in New York who manage relationships with specific corporate clients and have strong connections to corporate America. The bankers noted some of the hiring has been centered in regional investment banking, a push led by Mike Joo, who also left in August. Some bankers have also grumbled about the bank's pay and said this has been a factor in some departures. BofA's bonus structure for dealmakers, which increases deferred compensation in some cases, has given competitors such as JPMorgan and Citigroup (C.N) room to poach bankers from BofA, several people said. One person familiar with the matter acknowledged the bonus rules can be difficult for some bankers buying homes or paying tuition, but said the compensation structure is often not a deciding factor for senior hires. Senior executives deny morale is low. Strong revenue, involvement in deals like [USN:L4N45E0M9 TEXT:"Paramount Skydance buying Warner Bros Discovery"], where it was an adviser, and aggressive hiring contribute to a buoyant mood, they say. "Our people are seeing the benefits of the talented colleagues joining our firm, our investments in technology and the momentum we have with respect to our leading roles in marquee transactions," the BofA spokesperson said.

item.title: Apple needs new iPhones and smart-home push to revive pricey stock
item.description: The iPhone maker is holding a smart-home products event on Tuesday featuring an Apple doorbell and Apple thermostat ...
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: By Ryan Vlastelica Apple Inc. is rolling out a slew of new products and improved older ones this week, but investors are unsure if it will be enough to boost one of the most expensive stocks in the market that’s largely gone nowhere in months. The iPhone maker is holding a smart-home products event on Tuesday featuring an Apple doorbell and Apple thermostat, according to a Bloomberg News report. Later this month, the company is planning to launch a touchscreen MacBook and a new iPad mini. And on Friday, pre-orders begin for the new foldable iPhone Duo, which represents the biggest design change in the history of Apple’s most profitable device and carries a commensurately hefty price tag. The stakes are high for Apple shares, which soared to a record in late July amid reports about its push into the smart-home market and skepticism about heavy artificial intelligence spending that Apple has avoided. But the stock is basically flat in the months since. “For a company of this size, you need super-hit products to move the needle on growth,” said Peter Andersen, who helps oversee $5.5 billion as chief investment officer of Andersen Capital Management. “I’m just not sure anything we’re getting is exciting enough to lead to an inflection.”  The stock is up 25% this year, making Apple the top performer among the Magnificent Seven tech giants. It trades at more than 35 times earnings estimated over the next 12 months, right around its highest multiple since 2007 and well above its 10-year average of 24. Apple is among the 50 most expensive stocks in the S&P 500 Index, which is priced at 19 times forward earnings.  Some of that reflects Apple’s unique position within the AI trade, where it isn’t exposed to spending risk but is considered a key beneficiary of the technology’s development. And it shows investors’ high expectations for new Chief Executive Officer John Ternus and their hopes that he can generate growth by upgrading and expanding its lineup of devices. That’s a risk, however. The company has cut component orders for some iPhone models due to weaker-than-expected demand, according to a Bloomberg Intelligence report last week. Meanwhile, consumers are feeling pressured by stubborn inflation, and Apple has had to raise prices due to higher costs for components like memory chips.  “Apple executes its products flawlessly, but it’s hard to expect these will really take off,” said Andersen, who doesn’t own the stock, in part due to what he sees as the company’s lack of innovation. “Not only have there been major players in the home market for years, but Apple is launching these products into a market where consumers are under a lot of pressure.” What’s more, Apple’s growth rate is lagging its Big Tech peers, making its high stock market valuation stand out even more than it already does. The company’s fiscal year ended on Sept. 30, and it’s projected to post a 15% rise in annual revenue when it reports earnings in a few weeks. But that appears to be a near-peak, with the pace expected to slow to 10% in fiscal 2027 and 7.8% in fiscal 2028.  “Apple doesn’t look like a value stock or a growth stock,” Andersen said. “Given where the multiple is, it seems questionable to expect much additional stock upside from here.” Of course, Apple isn’t alone in its slowing growth. Overall tech sales are expected to experience a deceleration in the coming years, albeit off a much higher level. Revenue is projected to climb 37% for the S&P 500 information tech sector in 2026, and 29% in 2027, according to Bloomberg Intelligence. Whether Apple’s new products will alter the company’s earnings outlook remains to be seen. But Wall Street hasn’t been racing to adjust its projections. Analysts’ expectations for the company’s fiscal 2027 net income have dipped by 0.6% over the past three months, while their view for revenue has risen 0.7%.  “Apple’s product path seems promising, but I don’t think the first generation of new products will mean much for overall revenue,” said Lu Zhang, founder and managing partner of Fusion Fund, who owns the stock in her personal portfolio. “It remains to be seen whether we will see the kind of new use cases (for the foldable Duo) that will contribute to a broad upgrade cycle.” Nevertheless, Zhang remains positive on the stock. Apple could improve its AI offerings, she said, but it will continue to benefit from being a gateway for consumers to access the emerging technology. “All the AI companies are competing with each other, but whenever they launch a new model they need Apple as a key distribution channel, and that’s an area where it essentially has no competitor,” she said. “Even if Duo adoption isn’t high right out of the gate, so long as Apple continues to execute on its hardware, it will warrant a premiere multiple.” Tech Chart of the Day

item.description: [シンガポール １３日 ロイター] - 米ブラックロックの調査部門ブラックロック・インベストメント・インスティテュー...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ブラックロック、米国株の投資判断引き下げ　米国債は引き上げ 10/13 18:48 配信

ニューヨーク証券取引所で8月撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

[シンガポール １３日 ロイター] - 米ブラックロックの調査部門ブラックロック・インベストメント・インスティテュート（ＢＩＩ）は、ＡＩ（人工知能）を巡るボラティリティーを理由に、米国株の投資判断を「中立」に引き下げた。一方、米国債の投資判断は引き上げ、短期債を選好する姿勢を示した。

ＢＩＩのトップ、ジャン・ボワバン氏、ブラックロック債券部門のリック・リーダー最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）、同社のグローバル・チーフ・ストラテジスト、ウェイ・リー氏は１２日付のリポートで、長らく維持してきた米国株の「オーバーウエート」判断を解消し、中立に引き下げたと説明した。「ＡＩ関連の設備投資拡大に関連する潜在的なボラティリティーに対応するため」とした。

ＢＩＩは、過去６年間の大半で維持してきた米国債の「アンダーウエート」判断も解消する。利上げ観測が行き過ぎているとして、短期債を「オーバーウエート」に引き上げる。

長期の米国債は中立に引き上げ、日本国債に対する弱気姿勢も和らげる。投資のリスクとリターンのバランスが改善したと説明した。

item.title: Tighter AI data access could cost Germany €155 billion a year, ifo says
item.description: Germany risks losing €155 billion ($173.43 billion) in additional annual value added if access to AI training data is tightened, the ifo economic institute said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Cian Muenster, Leo Marchandon
item.content:encoded: Germany risks losing €155 billion ($173.43 billion) in additional annual value added if access to AI training data is tightened, the ifo economic institute said on Tuesday. The findings come as European policymakers and technology companies seek to balance the risks posed by AI with the need to foster innovation, as the region races to catch up with the United States and China in developing advanced models. "Anyone who wants a leading European AI model cannot at the same time make access to training data unnecessarily complicated. You cannot have both," ifo expert Oliver Falck said. Generative AI could add €440 billion a year to Germany's economy by 2034, but the loss would stem from slower AI adoption (€45 billion), weaker models (€75 billion), lower research output (€25 billion) and reduced AI development in Europe (€10 billion), according to the influential German institute's model calculation. "Access to diverse, high-quality training data is essential for competitive AI. Unnecessary restrictions and legal uncertainty make its development harder," German AI lab Aleph Alpha CEO Ilhan Scheer told Reuters. "Europe should make full use of its existing legal framework," he added. The authors urged policymakers to preserve the EU's text-and-data-mining exemption for commercial use, while setting proportionate transparency requirements and a practical opt-out standard. They said regulatory uncertainty was already deterring investment in Europe. AI can only realise its potential if access to data is not unnecessarily restricted, said Florian Schewor, DACH managing director at data processing company Celonis, adding that German and European industries hold vast amounts of largely untapped data. The Munich-based institute recently [USN:L8N4520DE TEXT:"criticised"] the German government for using debt-financed fiscal leeway intended for infrastructure and defence spending for other purposes. ($1 = 0.8937 euros)

item.title: Eleven sailors missing after drone sinks ship off Bulgaria
item.description: SOFIA: Eleven sailors were missing at sea on Tuesday (Oct 13) from a ship sunk by a drone attack off the coast of Bulgaria, the second deadly sinking of a cargo vessel in the area in a week, prompting Bulgaria to summon Russia's ambassador.Two cargo ships were hit by drones overnight and one was sunk, Bulgari

Eleven sailors missing after drone sinks ship off Bulgaria

FAST

SOFIA: Eleven sailors were missing at sea on Tuesday (Oct 13) from a ship sunk by a drone attack off the coast of Bulgaria, the second deadly sinking of a cargo vessel in the area in a week, prompting Bulgaria to summon Russia's ambassador. Two cargo ships were hit by drones overnight and one was sunk, Bulgarian officials said. Bulgaria stopped short of explicitly accusing Russia of carrying out the attacks but Prime Minister Rumen Radev said their outcome "benefits the Russian Federation". There was no immediate comment from Moscow on the incidents. "This is absolutely unacceptable - another attack in the immediate vicinity of Bulgarian territorial waters," Radev said in a televised address.

The attacks were also condemned by Ukraine and the EU. "The Black Sea has become another front of escalation of the Russian war in Ukraine," European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said on X. "Those responsible should be held accountable." Ukraine's Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said on X on Tuesday that the strike "once again demonstrates Moscow's deliberate disregard for civilian lives". "The Black Sea is a lifeline for global food security. Russia is attacking it to weaponise hunger and hold the world hostage," he said. BLACK SEA SHIPPING DRAWN INTO WAR Bulgarian officials said five crew members had been rescued but 11 were still listed as missing from the ship which sank off the coast of the village of Krapets. Bulgarian media identified the vessel as the cargo ship Azov Concord. Its Türkiye-based manager was not immediately available for comment. Another ship, the Chelsea 3 sailing under Maltese flag, was also hit by three drones overnight, Bulgarian officials said. All crew from that ship - seven Ukrainians and eight Azerbaijanis - were rescued and none seriously injured. A week ago nine Syrian sailors and one Egyptian were lost at sea from a ship that sank when hit by drones in Bulgaria's Black Sea exclusive economic zone. Another ship was also hit that night but the crew was rescued. More than four and a half years into the war that Moscow launched with its full-scale invasion in 2022, Black Sea shipping has increasingly been drawn into a prolonged battle of economic endurance. Ukraine and Russia are both among the world's largest exporters of grain. Russia has been bombing Ukraine's Black Sea ports, forcing Ukraine to rely increasingly on river ports on the Danube and shipping routes close to the coasts of NATO members Bulgaria and Romania. Ukraine, for its part, has increasingly targeted Russian grain-exporting ships in other parts of the Black Sea and the Azov Sea at the mouth of the Don River.

Related:

Two dead, 11 rescued after ship catches fire and sinks in Black Sea, Romania says

item.title: インド中銀のルピー防衛策、フォワード取引に想定外の影響
item.description:
Nimesh Vora Jaspreet Kalra
[ムンバイ １３日 ロイター] - インド準備銀行（中央銀行）...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
インド中銀のルピー防衛策、フォワード取引に想定外の影響 10/13 18:18 配信

ムンバイにあるインド準備銀行（RBI）本部前で4月撮影。 REUTERS/Francis Mascarenhas

Nimesh Vora　Jaspreet Kalra

[ムンバイ １３日 ロイター] - インド準備銀行（中央銀行）は通貨ルピーを支えるため厳しい規制措置を相次いで打ち出した。これにより複数の銀行がドル・ルピーのフォワード取引で気配値の提示を控えるという想定外の事態が生じている。銀行関係者が明らかにした。

関係者によると、一連の措置とドル購入に対する監視強化により、新規制の適用範囲や追加措置の有無を巡り不透明感が広がっている。

ルピーは先週、中銀が約４年ぶりに利上げしたにもかかわらず、１ドル＝９６．９６ルピーと過去最安値に迫る水準まで下落した。中銀はこれを受けて規制措置を導入した。その後ルピーは９５．２５ルピーまで回復した。

バークレイズのアジア外国為替・新興国マクロ戦略責任者ミトゥル・コテチャ氏は「インド中銀はルピー安が行き過ぎている可能性を示唆する段階から、外国為替市場でのドル需要と投機的な取引を直接抑え込む段階に移った」と述べた。

「こうした措置でドル需要が生じる時期や場所、調達コストに影響を与えることはできる。だが貿易やヘッジの必要性、資本流出に伴う実需をなくすことはできない」と指摘した。

＜想定外の影響＞

銀行関係者によると、１３日の取引序盤には、国営、民間、外資系の大手銀行少なくとも８行がドル・ルピーのフォワード取引で気配値の提示を控えた。

背景にあるのは、中銀が１２日夜に出した通達だ。銀行が自らの資産・負債の為替リスクをヘッジするためにルピーのデリバティブ契約を利用する場合、リスクに備えた準備金を積むよう義務付けた。銀行が外貨を購入する全てのルピーのデリバティブ契約に適用される。

銀行側はこの規定により、証拠金の要件が銀行間取引にも適用されると解釈した。このためドル・ルピーのフォワード取引で気配値を提示するかどうか再検討する動きが出た。ただ、中銀の考えに詳しい関係者は、この解釈は誤りだと指摘した。マーケットメークやトレーディングを目的とするデリバティブは通達の対象外だという。

銀行関係者によると、８行のうち３行は中銀から個別に説明を受け、フォワード取引の気配値提示を再開した。他の為替トレーダーは、正式な通知を待ってから銀行間取引での気配値提示を再開するとしている。

銀行が気配値の提示を控えたことで、ドル・ルピーのフォワード取引量は減少し、売値と買値の差が拡大して、相場は大きく変動した。大手外銀の関係者によると、国内市場でのヘッジ費用が高くなるとの懸念から、顧客の取引はノンデリバラブルフォワード（ＮＤＦ）市場に移った。

ＭＵＦＧはルピーが来年７─９月期までに１ドル＝９７．５０ルピーへ緩やかに下落すると予想している。ルピー安がさらに進めば、追加措置が講じられるとみている。

ＭＵＦＧの上級通貨アナリスト、マイケル・ワン氏はリポートで「ルピーにかかる根本的な圧力が和らぐには、結局のところインドの基礎的な資金フローが変わる必要がある」と述べた。

item.title: 中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝前場の下げから戻す、ＡＩ関連への売り一服
item.description: [香港 １３日 ロイター] - 中国・香港株式市場は前場の下げから回復して引けた。アジア全域で広がった人工知能（ＡＩ）...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝前場の下げから戻す、ＡＩ関連への売り一服 10/13 18:15 配信

[香港 １３日 ロイター] - 中国・香港株式市場は前場の下げから回復して引けた。アジア全域で広がった人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の売りが一服した。

上海総合指数は前営業日比０．１％高で終了。前場で一時１．４％下落し、３カ月ぶり安値を付けていた。ＣＳＩ３００指数は下げを一部取り戻し、０．３％安で引けた。

香港市場ではハンセン指数が０．３％高と上昇に転じて取引を終えた。一方、ハンセンテック指数は０．８％安で、マイナス圏にとどまった。

中東での紛争拡大や世界的な利回り上昇を受け、リスク選好度は低調となっている。

アジア株はこの日急落した。ＡＩ関連株高の持続性や競争激化への懸念が広がった。

明日発表される９月の中国輸出は、一部貿易相手国からの圧力にもかかわらず堅調な勢いを維持すると予想されている。ロイター調査によると、輸出は米ドル建てで前年比２５．５％増と、８月の２５％増から加速する見通し。

上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け市場「科創板」５０指数と、深セン証券取引所の新興企業向け市場「創業板（チャイネクスト）」総合指数は、いずれも前場の大幅安から反転した。

ＣＳＩ人工知能指数は６カ月ぶり安値を付けた後、０．３％安で終了。ＣＳＩ半導体指数は０．５％高だが、７月のピークから３０％超下落している。

主力銘柄の長鑫存儲技術（ＣＸＭＴ）は、メモリー半導体設計の進展に関する報道にもかかわらず、一時５．３％下落し７月以来の安値を付けた。終値は３％安だった。

国金証券のアナリストはリポートで「最近の急激な調整の後でも、これらハイテク株のファンダメンタルズに対する投資家の懸念が完全に織り込まれたとは言い難い」と指摘した。米国でもＡＩ関連の相場上昇が一服する中、中国のハイテク株は当面反発に苦戦するとの見方を示した。

新エネルギー車（ＮＥＶ）関連株は下落した。中国が２７年４月から付加価値税の輸出還付率を引き下げると発表した。ＣＳＩ新エネルギー車指数は３％近く下げて取引を終えた。
